## How it was tested

- [ ] `cargo test --release` passes
- [ ] a test covers the change (a bug fix has a test that fails before and passes after)
- [ ] this does not change a hash, a serialization or a validity rule (if it does, it was discussed first and the frozen vectors and the Python implementations are updated)
- [ ] no secret, key, wallet or personal data is included
- [ ] new text, code and messages are in English
